messages:
Ops-Bot: :rotating_light: Incident opened — edge-egress-degradation in eu-west1. Key symptom: packet drops to CDN egress gateways. Auto-triage suspected ISP flap.
Mina: seeing elevated 5xx and client disconnects from the eu-west1 edge pool. Rolling window of 3m error spike at 03:12 UTC.
Sanjeev: grabbing logs now. I see TCP retransmit spikes on gw-egress-*-eu-west1. probed upstream, some AS paths show high latency.
Mina: can you paste `tc -s qdisc` from a few hosts? want to rule out local queueing.
Sanjeev: pasted: `qdisc mq 0: dev eth0 root` then `backlog 3200b requeues 12` on 4/12 hosts. also `ip route get` shows next hop via isp-b.
Sanjeev: suspected BGP flap with ISP-B peering — traceroutes to cdn-edge show asymmetric paths.
Raul: customers reporting increased generation latency and some timeouts. product dashboard shows higher re-try rates for chat endpoints in eu region.
Jess: support queue has 18 open tickets tagged eu-west1. Top ones: INC-7789 (FinServCustomer), INC-7790 (MediaPartner). Both high priority.
Mina: decision point: do we shift traffic to eu-west2 / us-east1? Cost and latency tradeoffs.
Sanjeev: eu-west2 has spare capacity but different POP; cold KV caches will upswing token cost. us-east1 has plenty but adds cross-region egress and ~80ms median.
CFO-Proxy: note — cross-region egress will incur ~2.5x egress cost for affected tokens. need quick approval for emergency spend.
Raul: recommend controlled reroute only for tenants in SLA tier + critical support tickets. minimize blast radius.
Mina: agree. plan: 1) update status page 2) shift canary of 5% traffic from eu-west1 -> eu-west2 3) monitor error and latency 4) escalate to full shift if stable for 10 min.
Sanjeev: can implement policy using routing tag `egress-prefer:eu-west2` and `burst:region-override`. Will run rollout with `routed-cli traffic-shift --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --percent 5 --tag canary`.
Sanjeev: running canary now.
Mina: monitor windows: latency, 5xx %, retransmits. set alert if 5xx > 2% or p95 latency increase > 40%.
Ops-Bot: Deploy started: `routed-cli traffic-shift ... percent=5`. Watch logs: /var/log/route-controller/shift-1998765432.log
Sanjeev: canary shows reduced 5xx for those flows. retransmits on origin path still high, but traffic succeeded via eu-west2.
Jess: updating customers: drafting status page message — preview: "We are experiencing degraded connectivity from eu-west1 edge egress to some CDN endpoints. We are routing a portion of traffic to alternate POPs to mitigate impact. Some users may see increased latency. ETA for mitigation: 15-30 minutes."
Mina: tweak: include affected endpoints: chat.generate, chat.stream, embeddings.vectorize. add note: support is triaging high-priority customers by hand.
Jess: posted to status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1998765432 — message matches suggestion and links to support ticket list.
Customer-Alert-Bot: message queued to impacted customers for INC-7789 and INC-7790. Template: "We’re routing your traffic to an alternate POP to restore service; expect slightly higher latency. Contact support for dedicated routing."
CFO-Proxy: approved emergency spend cap +$6k for duration of incident. confirm before full shift.
Raul: can we estimate extra token spend? Sanjeev?
Sanjeev: rough calc: extra egress + cache misses => ~30% cost delta for affected tenants. If we shift 100% -> ~+$4k/hr for current load. Can do partial to stay under CFO cap.
Mina: proceed with staged escalation: hold canary 10m, if stable escalate to 30% for 5m, then 100% if stable and CFO approves full shift.
Sanjeev: canary stable at +8m. increasing to 30%.
Ops-Bot: traffic-shift increased to 30% by Sanjeev.
Mina: monitoring — p95 latency for shifted flow ~+60ms but 5xx down to baseline. looks good.
Jess: updating status page: add ETA update -> "Mitigation in progress; partial traffic shifted. We will post next update in 15 minutes."
Support-Janitor: queued personalized messages for high-impact customers offering dedicated routing and credits.
Mina: request on-call network to push ISP-B peering alert to provider and request reroute. @sre-oncall can you escalate with traceroute attachments?
sre-oncall: pinged provider; opened ticket with ISP-B ref TKT-5632; they acknowledge and are investigating.
Mina: prep rollback plan in case eu-west2 spikes or causes new issues: `routed-cli traffic-shift --to eu-west1 --percent X` and `--dry-run` to pre-validate.
Sanjeev: CFO gave green for up to +$6k, we can go to 100% if necessary. confirm final? @raul
Raul: OK proceed if customer impact persists. Approve 100% if required.
Mina: escalating to full shift now to minimize errors for high-tier tenants. will exclude lower-tier to control cost.
Ops-Bot: executing full shift for SLAs only.
Sanjeev: shift complete for SLA tenants. monitoring. no regressions seen in last 3 minutes.
Jess: updating status page final: "Partial mitigation complete for critical customers. ISP provider still investigating root cause. We will keep status updated every 30 minutes or on major changes."
Mina: action items: follow up with ISP until BGP flap resolved, keep support looped for any re-route issues, post final RCA when done.
Raul: thanks team. post-incident we should review routing fallback cost policy and add automatic spend guardrails.
Mina: agreed. closing thread once ISP confirms restore and metrics fully recovered.
